text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki hasn't been feeling great
lately, so we decide to visit a shrine
together. After we're done
praying, she
turns to me.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for coming with me. I hope I
wasn't too
much of a burden.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hehe. That's a relief.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I actually train at this shrine by myself
quite
often.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I thought I might feel better if I came
here, but...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Gaaah!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hm? That voice sounds familiar...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We see Special Week and Silence
Suzuka
sprinting up the stairs.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff... Huff...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huff... Wheeze... You're amazing, Spe... You almost... overtook me there...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Guh! I want a rematch!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Sure thing. But I'm not going to
let you win.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
You don't need to! I'm gonna get you for
sure this
time!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Those darling ponies are absolutely
glowing with
brilliance!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: They're even brighter than usual!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hm, I suppose I could...
choice_data_list: Aren't you going to call out to her?
Aren't you going to say something?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: But I think I'll refrain.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to impede on their
competition.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Instead, how about we pray again and
ask that all
their hard work pays off?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's the least I can do to thank them for
inspiring
me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki's expression lights up, as if
the clouds
brooding over her mind have
parted.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I can't find the right words to say to
them now...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Besides, compared to how luminous they
are, I'm
no more than—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Sorry. I didn't mean to bring the mood
down.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Let's go before they spot us.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki leaves the shrine, looking
downcast...
